sectionExplainer.bodyText: Check this out - I built a running list of all the Spidey sightings and events. An easy way to make sure you're seeing all the latest updates.
Honestly, it's hard to keep track of all the bad guys Spidey takes on, so I've started a collection with all the info I've put together from sightings.
My sources tell me that Spider-Man might be making an appearance at some events… If you want to pop in yourself, they're all listed here.

articles.name: SCORPION
articles.desc: Feels like there's history between Spidey and Scorpion, but I might be reading into it too much. He's got a lethal mechanical tail that you do not want to be stung by.

articles.name: BOOMERANG
articles.desc: His name is easy to catch; his weapons are not. Boomerang fights by using (surprise, surprise) special boomerangs with different powers.

articles.name: TARANTULA
articles.desc: Tarantula uses poison-tipped boots as a weapon, so watch those feet. Luckily, Spidey has great reflexes.

articles.name: THE HAND
articles.desc: Can someone tell me what NINJAS are doing back in New York? The all-red outfits do go kinda hard but feels like it'd be hard to sneak around in.

articles.name: PUNISHER
articles.desc: Is he a friend of Spider-Man? They've been spotted together but it doesn't always look like they're working as one. Either way, I'd want to stay on his good side (if he has one).

articles.name: UNKNOWN
articles.desc: There are rumors of a new mysterious villain in the city.  Send anything you hear about this, this one's hard to track.
